name: Mending Touch
description: The spell she tried to use on the chicken cart. She wanted to fix the wheel. It turned the cart into a chicken. But the principle was right: mending. If she concentrates very hard, she can make worn things whole again. Mostly.

params.message: She presses her hands to the worn thing and closes her eyes. Her brow furrows with effort. For a moment nothing happens. Then a soft green glow, and the cracks knit together.
The thing feels sturdier in your hands.
